Package org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker

Class NavNode

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker.NavNode
public final class NavNode extends Object
One node in the console navigation tree. Nodes nest to any depth; <@node> directives append to the node returned by PageCapture.navRoot().
Example:

NavNode root = PageCapture.of(env).navRoot(); NavNode home = root.add("home", "Home", "/home"); home.add("about", "About", "/home/about"); root.find(List.of("home", "about")).map(NavNode::label); // Optional[About]

Since:
10.0.0
